stageNotes: Stage 1 — Canonical: apex returns 200 cleanly; www.frontierfirearms.ca/ → 301 → frontierfirearms.ca/. canonicalOrigin = https://frontierfirearms.ca

Stage 2 — WAF/CAPTCHA: Cloudflare passive (cf-ray + __cf_bm on every response). All 8 heavy-probe batches 200 on customer paths; honeypots 403 from BC origin (HTML body is BC 'Sorry...' template not CF challenge); rapid burst 10x in <8s all 200; SQLi 200; XSS 400 origin; no-UA 200; bot UA 200. No CAPTCHA markers (recaptcha/hcaptcha/turnstile) in HTML. No age-gate markup. hasWaf=false (operational), wafType=cloudflare-passive (informational).

Stage 3 — Platform: BigCommerce Stencil — definitive markers: x-bc-store-id: 10041189 response header, BC-Ray header, fornax_anonymousId / SHOP_SESSION_TOKEN cookies, link header pointing at cdn11.bigcommerce.com/s-7rboesvul1/stencil/.../theme-bundle.head_async.js, .html category URL extension. adapterType=generic-retail per platform→adapter default table.

Stage 4 — Catalog: Top-level nav yielded 7 root cats (firearms.html, equipment, scopes-optics, surplus, security-devices.html, buy-online.html, body-armor-kevlar) + many sitemap-listed subcats. Walked 40+ candidates with ?limit=100 + pagination = 709 unique products. Extended to ~100 sitemap entries before budget cap: 607 unique (overlap with first 40). Sitemap product total = 1281. Coverage gap ~45-55% likely due to deep BC subcat leaves not yet enumerated. catalogUrls = 40 most-productive paths from nav + sitemap-listed subcats. extractionTested=true with 3 product samples (title/url/price/stock all populated correctly via BC article.card pattern).

Stage 5 — Pagination: ?page=2 vs ?page=1 zero-overlap confirmed (14 IDs on p2, 0 overlap with p1's 40 IDs). type=query, template='page', firstPageHasParam=false, startPage=1, zeroIndexed=false. perPage=50 (BC Stencil default; limit=100 honored but server-side caps at 100/page; chose 50 as the safest default option from in-page select).

Stage 6 — Sort: 3-outcome counter-control test on /firearms.html. Default first 5 IDs [26023,26025,26026,26027,26028] exactly match sort=newest first 5; sort=alphaasc first 5 differs [21962,24590,24765,25444,25853]. Verdict: honored-default-is-newest. sortParam='?sort=newest' (explicit, even though default is already newest — explicit is safer for runtime URL building per Mistake 29 / BC Stencil quirk).

Stage 7 — Watermark: navigate-from-watermark. Sort verified honored (Stage 6) and default DOM order IS newest-first (descending product IDs). No api-date-since-watermark available for BC Stencil without store-token auth. full-catalog-sweep avoided as fallback because navigate-from-watermark works.

Stage 8 — Count: productCountMethod={method:'sitemap', url:'https://frontierfirearms.ca/xmlsitemap.php?type=products&page=1'}. 1281 <loc> entries in single-page sitemap (page=2 returns 404). Includes OOS / hidden by design — that's a feature for BC Stencil where category pages may hide OOS items, supporting back-in-stock alerts and full inventory tracking.

Stage 9 — Assembly: 40 catalogUrls covering observed productive paths. Coverage gap (~45-55%) noted in fieldConfidence — operator may need to add deeper subcat leaves or sitemap-product-walk fallback at runtime to reach 100%. Audit-time budget cap of 100 sitemap categories prevented walking all 244. Skill output written for operator review; no DB write.
